sources_tried: Seed file wichita.json: worked. Useful leads were M Divisions, Evans Supply and Solutions (Haysville) and SGH Concepts. The rest were remodelers, plumbers, glass shops and stores. The web results were remodelers or out-of-area pages.
Bobrick find-a-rep: page loads, but the rep list comes from a dropdown, so no Kansas rep was readable.
Scranton Products find-a-rep: 404. Hadrian find-a-rep: 404. Metpar /representatives: 404.
ASI/Global Partitions find-a-rep: 403. General Partitions find-a-rep: 403.
Bradley find-a-rep: 200, but the content is dynamic and shows no Kansas reps. Ampco/Ammco: not tried.
The Blue Book: search URL blocked (403); no Blue Book results came up in WebSearch.
BuildingConnected / Procore public profiles: not tried (search cap).

WebSearch: 8 of 8 used. The searches were dominated by One Point Partitions (an online seller with a Wichita 'delivery terminal' and no installation shown, excluded). They also surfaced Southwest Solutions Group, The Partition Pros (DFW crew, excluded), Q4 Industries (Lenexa, about 190 mi, excluded) and DSD Drywall (kept). The bid-tabulation and Bing searches gave nothing useful.
BBB category pages (Wichita and Newton, partition): worked, giving Engineered Door Products.
Superpages and YellowPages searches ('toilet partitions', Wichita): worked, giving J F Custom Woods and Claco Supply. The rest were remodelers.

Company sites fetched: mdivisions.com, evanssupplyandsolutionsco.com (via curl), sghconcepts.com, dsdrywall.com, dhpace.com/locations, southwestsolutions.com (via curl), milestoneconstructioninc.com (a GC with no partition work, excluded), mckinneydoor.com (American Doors, TX/CO only, excluded) and newtondistributing.com (Natick MA, excluded). clacosupply.com returned 503. engineereddoorproducts.com didn't resolve. The dhpace.com carpentry and state pages were blocked by Cloudflare.
Also excluded: Newton Distributing (national online seller), Martin Bros (California), Partition Plus (no Kansas link), and the remodelers, plumbers and handymen from the Maps seed.

candidates.name: Danny Satterfield Drywall Corporation (DSD)
candidates.partition_evidence: Construction Specialties page: 'Our Division 10 services include: Toilet partitions and restroom components', plus corner guards and accessories installation.
candidates.reason: A Wichita commercial drywall contractor whose own Division 10 page lists toilet partition and restroom component installation; works in Kansas, Oklahoma and Missouri. It's a GC-facing subcontractor, so check whether it takes small direct jobs.
red_flags: Primarily a drywall/framing sub; partition work may be bundled in larger GC bid scopes

license.name: Danny Satterfield Drywall Corporation (DSD)
license.registry: Metropolitan Area Building and Construction Department (MABCD), City of Wichita / Sedgwick County, contractor licensing
license.license_type: MABCD general contractor license (Class A-D); class for commercial interior work unconfirmed
license.note: Kansas has no state contractor license; Wichita/Sedgwick County license general contractors through MABCD. MABCD's contractor licensing page (https://www.sedgwickcounty.org/mabcd/contractor-licensing/) offers no public license search or list, and the MABCD portal (https://mabcdportal.sedgwickcounty.org/) is a sign-in portal for permits and renewals. To verify a license, call MABCD at 316-660-1840 (number listed on the portal page). The company site (https://dsdrywall.com/) gives a Wichita, KS base and states no license number. No Kansas SOS entity check done.

candidates.name: Southwest Solutions Group (Wichita market)
candidates.partition_evidence: The toilet partition systems page offers 'sales, design, installation, and maintenance support for toilet partition systems'; it lists Kansas (office in Lenexa) with installation coverage statewide, including Wichita.
candidates.reason: A national storage and specialties dealer that sells and installs toilet partitions, with a Kansas page saying 'From Wichita, SSG supports projects across south central Kansas'. Its Kansas office is in Lenexa, beyond 120 miles, and it competes with us as a partition seller.
red_flags: Sells partitions itself (direct competitor / buy-around risk)
Office in Lenexa, about 170+ miles from Wichita; Wichita presence unclear
